name: rockrms
description: Rock RMS development environment for Codex: house rules injected at session start, Lava / T-SQL / HTMX language references, Rock database schema docs, BEMA Room Management docs, workbench skills for the Dynamic Data, HTML Content, Helix, Lava Tester, and SQL editor surfaces, pre-push audit skills, and a provenance-tiered knowledge catalog (rockrms-knowledge-current, rockrms-knowledge-future, rockrms-changelog, rockrms-add-knowledge).

interface.longDescription: House rules, language references (Lava, T-SQL, HTMX), Rock database schema docs, BEMA Room Management docs, workbench skills for each Rock surface, pre-push audits, and a provenance-tiered knowledge catalog for Rock RMS development.
defaultPrompt: Use $rockrms:rockrms-knowledge-current to show what the plugin documents.
Use $rockrms:format-tsql to restyle this query to house style.
Use $rockrms:rockrms-init to set up this directory as a Rock workspace.
